name: What are common signs of a damaged gas pipe?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of a damaged gas pipe?

acceptedAnswer.text: Identifying a damaged gas pipe early can prevent serious issues. Common signs include a distinct sulfur-like or rotten egg smell, which indicates a gas leak. You might also hear a hissing or whistling sound near a gas line, see discolored vegetation in your yard near underground gas lines, or experience dizziness or nausea if gas is leaking indoors. If you notice any of these signs, it's crucial to evacuate the area immediately and contact a professional gas line repair service like Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include a rotten egg smell, hissing sounds, discolored vegetation near gas lines, or feeling unwell indoors.
